Vault.title: Vault
Vault.description: A shared 3D wallet savings vault for two friends targeting May 2028.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who created the shared vault.

memberUids.description: Bounded array (max 2) of member UIDs authorized to view and contribute to this vault.

inviteCode.description: Unique invite code used by the friend to join the vault.

title.description: Name of the savings goal (e.g. May 2028 Ortak Hədəf).

targetAmount.description: Total target savings amount by May 2028.

totalSaved.description: Combined total saved by both friends.

ownerSaved.description: Total amount contributed by the vault owner.

partnerSaved.description: Total amount contributed by the partner friend.

ownerName.description: Display name of the vault owner.

partnerName.description: Display name of the joined partner friend.

partnerUid.description: UID of the joined partner friend (empty string before joining).

targetDateIso.description: ISO date string for the savings target (e.g. 2028-05-31).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Deposit.title: Deposit
Deposit.description: An individual savings contribution added into a shared vault by either friend.

vaultId.description: ID of the parent Vault document.

userId.description: UID of the member who made this deposit.

userName.description: Display name of the member who made this deposit.

memberUids.description: Denormalized member UIDs (max 2) for zero-latency shared list queries.

amount.description: Positive deposit amount added to the wallet.

note.description: Optional short note or milestone label for the deposit.

dayKey.description: YYYY-MM-DD date key for daily progress calculation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the deposit was recorded via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the deposit was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/vaults/{vaultId}.description: Shared savings vaults accessible to the two participating friends.

/deposits/{depositId}.description: Individual savings deposits linked to a shared vault.
